title: Qui sait ? (2)
author: Guy de Maupassant
note: Months after that night, the narrator travels to calm his nerves: Italy, Sicily, North Africa, and then Rouen, the old Norman city, with its narrow streets full of antique dealers. The story still uses the passé simple: "je vis", "il répondit", "je dus" mean "I saw", "he answered", "I had to".
